summary: Wrote the verified CLI and config references, added reference drift tests, linked both pages from the README, and extended the documentation link test.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Wrote the verified CLI and config references, added reference drift tests, linked both pages from the README, and extended the documentation link test.
decisions: The reference describes the real commander surface, including --json on mutation commands, rather than the narrower PRD 12.1 synopsis.
Config keys are checked against APP_SPEC_KEYS and their documented defaults against APP_SPEC_DEFAULTS.
warnings: PRD 12.1 omits --json for add, update, rollback, and remove while the CLI registers it; the reference documents the actual error-only JSON behavior.
The config --help text calls --path a directory path, but the command prints config.toml's path; the reference follows the code.
validationLimitations: No manual clean-shell walkthrough on a prepared Podman host was run; claims were verified against source and the CLI program.
Lint exits successfully but reports three pre-existing useTemplate infos in image-label source and test files.

Extend the docs link test.
